title: User Authentication with Role-Based Access
description: Verify that users can successfully log in with correct credentials and are granted access appropriate to their role (admin, manager, analyst). Unauthorized users or incorrect credentials should deny access.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Attempt login with valid admin credentials
Verify login success and admin privileges granted
Log out
Attempt login with valid manager credentials
Verify login success and manager privileges granted
Log out
Attempt login with valid analyst credentials
Verify login success and analyst privileges granted
Log out
Attempt login with invalid credentials
Verify login fails with appropriate error message
Attempt access to restricted pages without login
Verify access is denied and user is redirected to login page

title: Dashboard Real-Time Data Display
description: Validate that the dashboard shows up-to-date statistics, including reagent, standard, item, instrument counts, pending orders, and upcoming calendar events accurately.

steps.description: Log in as a manager or admin user
Navigate to the main dashboard
Verify reagent, standard, item, and instrument counts are displayed correctly
Verify pending orders count is shown and consistent with orders database
Verify calendar events (calibrations/maintenance) for upcoming dates are displayed
Add a new reagent entry and update inventory quantities
Verify dashboard updates reagent count in real-time
Simulate an instrument calibration event addition
Verify calendar view dynamically reflects the new event

title: Reagent CRUD Operations with Inventory Sync
description: Test full Create, Read, Update, Delete workflow for reagents including search, filtering, and warehouse stock synchronization ensuring FEFO standards and expiry monitoring.

steps.description: Log in as admin or manager
Navigate to reagents catalog
Create a new reagent with all required fields and upload an MSDS document
Verify reagent appears in catalog and document is properly stored and retrievable
Search for reagent by name and filter by expiry date
Verify search and filter results are accurate
Edit reagent details including stock batch data and expiry dates
Verify updates are reflected in reagent catalog and warehouse stock
Attempt to delete the reagent entry
Verify deletion confirmation prompt appears
Confirm deletion
Verify reagent and associated warehouse stock entries are removed
Create a reagent with expiry dates close to current date
Verify system correctly triggers expiry alerts in dashboard and reports

title: Order Creation and Approval Workflow
description: Validate creation, submission, and manager/admin approval of purchase orders with correct permission enforcement and state transitions.

steps.description: Log in as analyst and navigate to order creation page
Create a new order requesting inventory items
Verify order is saved in 'Pending' state
Log out and log in as manager
Navigate to orders awaiting approval
Approve the pending order
Verify order status updates to 'Approved'
Try to approve the same order again
Verify duplicate approval is prevented
Log in as analyst and attempt to approve order
Verify approval action is not permitted
Cancel a pending order
Verify confirmation prompt appears and order status is updated correctly upon confirmation

title: Training Sets Management and Inventory Adjustment
description: Test creation, updating, and usage tracking of training sets with automatic decrement of relevant inventory stock and audit logging.

steps.description: Log in as analyst
Create a new training set and assign inventory items
Verify training set details are saved and visible
Record usage of inventory items for training batch
Verify inventory stock quantities are correctly decremented
Verify usage logs are recorded with correct user and timestamp
Attempt to record usage exceeding available stock
Verify system prevents usage and displays warning

title: Instrument Calibration and Maintenance Logs with Scheduling and Notifications
description: Ensure calibration and maintenance logs are created, updated, and statuses changed automatically with correct scheduling and email reminders triggered as expected.

steps.description: Log in as instrument manager
Create a new instrument entry
Add calibration schedule and maintenance logs for the instrument
Verify entries are saved with correct timestamps and status set to 'Scheduled'
Simulate passing of calibration due date
Verify calibration status updates to 'Overdue'
Verify that email reminders are sent for upcoming and overdue calibrations
Update calibration logs marking calibration as completed
Verify calibration status updates to 'Completed' and next due date is recalculated
Upload calibration report and maintenance photos to instrument record
Verify documents and images are uploaded, stored properly, and accessible

title: AI Chat Interface Integration and Fallback Handling
description: Test AI chat assistant functionality querying real-time lab data via n8n webhook, including handling of webhook unavailability with graceful fallback responses.

steps.description: Log in as any user
Open AI chat interface
Send queries requesting inventory status, instrument data, MSDS info, and operational instructions
Verify accurate, up-to-date responses retrieved via n8n webhook
Simulate n8n webhook being unavailable or timing out
Verify chat provides fallback response politely indicating service unavailability
Send malformed query
Verify chat handles errors gracefully without crashing

title: File Upload and Download Functionality
description: Verify that users can upload and download supported files (images, documents, calibration reports, maintenance photos) tied to appropriate inventory or instrument entries with proper storage and retrieval.

steps.description: Log in with sufficient privileges
Navigate to reagent or instrument detail page
Upload supported file types including MSDS PDFs, images, and calibration reports
Verify upload success notification and file appears in file list
Download an uploaded file
Verify file downloads correctly and opens as expected
Attempt to upload unsupported or oversized files
Verify upload is rejected with descriptive error message

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement Across Features
description: Confirm that different user roles can access only authorized features and are prevented from unauthorized operations such as deletion, approval, and user management.

steps.description: Log in as analyst
Attempt to access admin user management pages
Verify access denied or redirect
Attempt to approve purchase orders
Verify approval actions are not available
Log in as manager
Attempt to delete user accounts
Verify deletion is restricted to admins only
Attempt to perform CRUD operations on inventory
Verify CRUD operations permitted for managers and denied for analysts on restricted entities

title: Automated Background Jobs Execution Verification
description: Validate that background jobs configured in n8n run on schedule, sending email reports and reminders for low stock, expiring items, and calibration events.

steps.description: Prepare test environment with low stock and expiring inventory items plus upcoming and overdue calibrations
Trigger or wait for scheduled n8n background jobs execution
Verify emails are sent to respective stakeholders with accurate report contents
Verify emails contain correct details on stock levels, expiry notifications, and calibration reminders
Simulate failure or delay of background job
Verify system logs the failure and fallback procedures if any

title: Usage Logs Auditing and Accuracy
description: Check that usage logs for chemicals and consumables are recorded correctly with user identity and precise timestamps, reflecting actual stock changes.

steps.description: Log in as analyst
Submit usage entries for chemicals and consumables
Verify usage logs record correct user, timestamp, and quantities used
Attempt to submit usage with invalid quantities (negative or exceeding stock)
Verify system rejects invalid inputs and displays appropriate error messages
Review audit trail for usage entries
Verify logs are immutable and accessible only to authorized users

title: UI Confirmation for Destructive Operations
description: Test that potentially destructive actions such as deletions or bulk updates prompt user confirmation dialogs to prevent accidental data loss.

steps.description: Log in as admin user
Attempt to delete an inventory reagent entry
Verify a confirmation dialog is displayed with clear options to proceed or cancel
Cancel the deletion
Verify the reagent remains intact and no data loss occurs
Attempt deletion again and confirm
Verify the deletion completes successfully and UI updates accordingly
